title: 环球扫描
title_en: Global Scan
summary: 《生物多样性公约》第十七次缔约方大会在埃里温开幕，将首次全球审查“昆蒙框架”落实进展。国际货币基金组织、世界银行与泰国央行发布“曼谷蓝图”，呼吁跨境合作打击金融诈骗。伊朗总统表示绝不屈服于“侵略性”国家无理要求与霸凌，军方称已制定应对方案。
summary_en: The 17th Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity opened in Yerevan and will conduct the first global review of progress on the Kunming-Montreal Framework. The IMF, World Bank and Bank of Thailand released the 'Bangkok Blueprint,' calling for cross-border cooperation to combat financial fraud. Iran's president said Iran will never yield to unreasonable demands and bullying from 'aggressive' countries, and the military said response plans are in place.

summary_en: The 7th CICA Summit was held in Baku on October 15, 2026. The declaration reaffirmed commitment to the UN Charter and principles of international law, stressed that CICA cooperation aims to promote regional peace, security, stability and development, and recognized CICA's contributions. summary: 普埃布拉彩陶是跨太平洋文化交流的产物。16世纪中叶西班牙开辟马尼拉至阿卡普尔科航线，中国青花瓷传入新西班牙，普埃布拉成为消费、分销与再创造节点。17至18世纪，当地陶工行会要求精品陶器模仿中国青花样式与晕染技法，陶工结合伊比利亚锡釉陶和中国
summary_en: Puebla polychrome pottery is a product of trans-Pacific cultural exchange. In the mid-16th century, Spain opened the Manila-Acapulco route, Chinese blue-and-white porcelain reached New Spain, and Puebla became a hub for consumption, distribution and re-creation. In the 17th and 18th centuries, local potters' guilds required fine ceramics to imitate Chinese blue-and-white styles and shading techniques, and potters combined Iberian tin-glazed pottery with Chinese blue-and-white techniques.

title: 全力推动商务高质量发展不断取得新成效（权威发布·开局起步“十五五”）
title_en: Make every effort to promote high-quality development of commerce and continuously achieve new results (Authoritative Release · Starting the 15th Five-Year Plan)
summary: 10月22日，国务院新闻办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”系列发布会，介绍推进“十五五”时期商务高质量发展有关情况。商务部表示，将立足商务工作“三个重要”定位，做强国内大循环、畅通国内国际双循环，围绕“活力更足、质量更高、共识更广、能力更强”四方
summary_en: On October 22, the State Council Information Office held a series of press conferences on 'Launching the 15th Five-Year Plan' to introduce advancing high-quality commercial development during the 15th Five-Year Plan period. The Ministry of Commerce said it will base its work on the 'three important' positioning of commerce, strengthen the domestic circulation and smooth the domestic and international dual circulation, and focus on the four aspects of 'more vitality, higher quality, broader consensus and stronger capabilities'.

summary_en: In a video address at the opening ceremony of the new Yalu River Bridge between China and North Korea, Li Qiang said the bridge is an important cross-border infrastructure project jointly championed by the top leaders of the two parties and countries, and its smooth opening will greatly promote economic and trade cooperation and personnel exchanges between the two countries, becoming a new landmark of traditional China-DPRK friendship.
